from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyObservation(BaseModel):
    """A single data point for a specific month extracted from one document."""
    month: str = Field(description="The month for which this data is valid, in YYYY-MM format")
    south_change: str = Field(description="Month-over-month percentage change for South housing starts")
    midwest_change: str = Field(description="Month-over-month percentage change for Midwest housing starts")
    report_release_date: str = Field(description="Date the document was released (YYYY-MM-DD) to determine precedence over conflicting reports")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    observations: list[MonthlyObservation]
